questions.stem: （填空题）设函数$f(x)$满足$f(x)+2f(\frac {2}{x})=x^{2}-\frac {1}{x^{2}}$，则曲线$y=f(x)$在点$(1,f(1))$处的切线方程为$y=$______。
（填空题）设函数$f(x) = \int_{0}^{x} \sqrt[3]{t - \frac{\pi}{4}} \sin 2t dt$，则$f(x)$在$[0, \pi]$上的最小值点为$x = \underline{\quad\quad}$
questions.answer:
**答案** $\pi$.

**解** 由变限积分的求导公式可得，$f'(x) = \sqrt[3]{x - \frac{\pi}{4}} \sin 2x$.

当$x \in \left(0, \frac{\pi}{4}\right)$时，$\sqrt[3]{x - \frac{\pi}{4}} < 0$，$\sin 2x > 0$，$f'(x) < 0$，$f(x)$单调减少；当$x \in \left(\frac{\pi}{4}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$时，$\sqrt[3]{x - \frac{\pi}{4}} > 0$，$\sin 2x > 0$，$f'(x) > 0$，$f(x)$单调增加；当$x \in \left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right)$时，$\sqrt[3]{x - \frac{\pi}{4}} > 0$，$\sin 2x < 0$，$f'(x) < 0$，$f(x)$单调减少. 于是，$x = \frac{\pi}{4}$为$f(x)$在$(0, \pi)$内的极小值点.

由于当$t \in \left(0, \frac{\pi}{4}\right)$时，$\sin 2t > 0$，故

$f\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right) = \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \sqrt[3]{t - \frac{\pi}{4}} \sin 2t dt > \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \sqrt[3]{0 - \frac{\pi}{4}} \sin 2t dt = -\sqrt[3]{\frac{\pi}{4}} \cdot \left(-\frac{\cos 2t}{2}\right)\bigg|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} = -\frac{1}{2}\sqrt[3]{\frac{\pi}{4}}.$

另一方面，

$f(0) = \int_{0}^{0} \sqrt[3]{t - \frac{\pi}{4}} \sin 2t dt = 0,$

$f(\pi) = \int_{0}^{\pi} \sqrt[3]{t - \frac{\pi}{4}} \sin 2t dt = \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sqrt[3]{t - \frac{\pi}{4}} \sin 2t dt + \int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} \sqrt[3]{t - \frac{\pi}{4}} \sin 2t dt$

$\stackrel{第一个积分中令u = t - \frac{\pi}{4}}{=} \int_{-\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \sqrt[3]{u} \cos 2u du + \int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} \sqrt[3]{t - \frac{\pi}{4}} \sin 2t dt$

$\stackrel{对称性}{=} 0 + \int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} \sqrt[3]{t - \frac{\pi}{4}} \sin 2t dt.$

由于当$t \in \left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right)$时，$\sin 2t < 0$，故

$\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} \sqrt[3]{t - \frac{\pi}{4}} \sin 2t dt < \int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} \sqrt[3]{\frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi}{4}} \sin 2t dt = \sqrt[3]{\frac{\pi}{4}} \cdot \left(-\frac{\cos 2t}{2}\right)\bigg|_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} = -\sqrt[3]{\frac{\pi}{4}}.$

由此可得，$f(\pi) < -\sqrt[3]{\frac{\pi}{4}} < -\frac{1}{2}\sqrt[3]{\frac{\pi}{4}} < f\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)$，$f(x)$在$[0, \pi]$上的最小值点为$x = \pi$。

questions.stem: （填空题）曲线\( y = \cos x \ (x \in \left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]) \)与x轴所围区域绕x轴旋转一周所得旋转体的侧面积\( S = \)______．
questions.answer:
\( 2\pi[\ln(\sqrt{2} + 1) + \sqrt{2}] \)．

解 计算可得\( y'(x) = -\sin x \)．由旋转体的侧面积公式可得

\( S = 2\pi\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \cos x \sqrt{1 + (-\sin x)^2} dx \stackrel{\text{对称性}}{=} 4\pi\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sqrt{1 + \sin^2 x} d(\sin x) \)

\( \stackrel{t = \sin x}{=} 4\pi\int_{0}^{1} \sqrt{1 + t^2} dt \)．

下面用两种方法计算\( \int_{0}^{1} \sqrt{1 + t^2} dt \)．

解法1 利用分部积分法．

\( \int_{0}^{1} \sqrt{1 + t^2} dt = t\sqrt{1 + t^2}\big|_{0}^{1} - \int_{0}^{1} t \cdot \frac{t}{\sqrt{1 + t^2}} dt = \sqrt{2} - \int_{0}^{1} \left( \sqrt{1 + t^2} - \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 + t^2}} \right) dt \)．

由此可得\( \int_{0}^{1} \sqrt{1 + t^2} dt = \frac{1}{2} \left( \sqrt{2} + \int_{0}^{1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 + t^2}} dt \right) \)．

由于\( \int_{0}^{1} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 + t^2}} dt = \ln(t + \sqrt{1 + t^2})\big|_{0}^{1} = \ln(\sqrt{2} + 1) \)，故\( \int_{0}^{1} \sqrt{1 + t^2} dt = \frac{1}{2}[\ln(\sqrt{2} + 1) + \sqrt{2}] \)．

解法2 令\( t = \tan u \)，则

\( \int_{0}^{1} \sqrt{1 + t^2} dt = \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \sec^3 u du = \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \sec u d(\tan u) = \sec u \tan u\big|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} - \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \tan u \cdot \sec u \tan u du \)

\( = \sqrt{2} - \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} (\sec^2 u - 1) \sec u du = \sqrt{2} - \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \sec^3 u du + \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \sec u du \)

= √2 - ∫₀^(π/4) sec³u du + ln(sec u + tan u) |₀^(π/4)

= √2 - ∫₀^(π/4) sec³u du + ln(√2 + 1)

由此可得∫₀¹ √(1 + t²) dt = ∫₀^(π/4) sec³u du = ½[ln(√2 + 1) + √2]

因此，S = 4π · ½[ln(√2 + 1) + √2] = 2π[ln(√2 + 1) + √2]

\( -e^2 dy \)．

解 将点 \( (0,0) \) 代入已知方程可得，\( \ln z(0,0) + 1 = 2 \)，解得 \( z(0,0) = e \)．

对已知方程两端分别关于 \( x,y \) 求偏导数可得

\[

\frac{1}{z} \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - \sin x = 0, \quad \frac{1}{z} \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} + z + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = 0.

\]

将 \( x = 0, y = 0, z = e \) 代入上述两方程，可得 \( \frac{1}{e} \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,0)} = 0 \)，\( \frac{1}{e} \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\bigg|_{(0,0)} + e = 0 \)，解得 \( \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,0)} = 0 \)，\( \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\bigg|_{(0,0)} = -e^2 \)．

因此，\( dz|_{(0,0)} = -e^2 dy \)．

questions.stem: （填空题）设函数$f_{n}(x)=c_{n}x^{2n}\text{e}^{-\pi x^{2}}$，且满足$\int_{0}^{+\infty}f_{n}(x)\text{d}x = \frac{1}{2}$，其中$c_{n}$为仅与$n$有关的数. 若$c_{0}=1$，则$c_{4} = $______.
questions.answer:
$\frac{16\pi^{4}}{105}$

解 记$I_{n} = \int_{0}^{+\infty}x^{2n}\text{e}^{-\pi x^{2}}\text{d}x$，则$\int_{0}^{+\infty}f_{n}(x)\text{d}x = c_{n}I_{n}$. 当$n \geqslant 1$时，

$I_{n} = \int_{0}^{+\infty}x^{2n}\text{e}^{-\pi x^{2}}\text{d}x = -\frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{0}^{+\infty}x^{2n - 1}\text{d}(\text{e}^{-\pi x^{2}})$

$= -\frac{1}{2\pi}\left[ x^{2n - 1}\text{e}^{-\pi x^{2}}\bigg|_{0}^{+\infty} - (2n - 1)\int_{0}^{+\infty}x^{2n - 2}\text{e}^{-\pi x^{2}}\text{d}x \right]$

$= \frac{2n - 1}{2\pi}\int_{0}^{+\infty}x^{2n - 2}\text{e}^{-\pi x^{2}}\text{d}x = \frac{2n - 1}{2\pi}I_{n - 1}$.

由此可得

$I_{4} = \frac{7}{2\pi}I_{3} = \frac{7}{2\pi} \cdot \frac{5}{2\pi}I_{2} = \cdots = \frac{7}{2\pi} \cdot \frac{5}{2\pi} \cdot \frac{3}{2\pi} \cdot \frac{1}{2\pi} I_{0}. \quad (1)$

又因为$c_{0}=1$，而$\int_{0}^{+\infty}c_{0}\text{e}^{-\pi x^{2}}\text{d}x = \frac{1}{2}$，所以$I_{0} = \int_{0}^{+\infty}\text{e}^{-\pi x^{2}}\text{d}x = \frac{1}{2}$. 从而由(1) 式可得$I_{4} = \frac{105}{32\pi^{4}}$.

由于$\int_{0}^{+\infty}f_{4}(x)\text{d}x = c_{4}I_{4} = \frac{1}{2}$，故$c_{4} = \frac{16\pi^{4}}{105}$.

questions.stem: （填空题）设矩阵\( A = \begin{pmatrix} 0 & t & 1 \\ -1 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \end{pmatrix} \)相似于实对角矩阵，则\( t \)的取值范围是______
questions.answer:
\( \left( -\infty, \frac{5}{4} \right) \).

解 首先计算\( A \)的特征值.

\( |\lambda E - A| = \begin{vmatrix} \lambda & -t & -1 \\ 1 & \lambda & -1 \\ -1 & -1 & \lambda \end{vmatrix} \xrightarrow{c_1 + c_3} \begin{vmatrix} \lambda - 1 & -t & -1 \\ 0 & \lambda & -1 \\ \lambda - 1 & -1 & \lambda \end{vmatrix} = (\lambda - 1) \begin{vmatrix} 1 & -t & -1 \\ 0 & \lambda & -1 \\ 1 & -1 & \lambda \end{vmatrix} \)

\( = (\lambda - 1) \begin{vmatrix} 1 & -t & -1 \\ 0 & \lambda & -1 \\ 0 & t - 1 & \lambda + 1 \end{vmatrix} = (\lambda - 1)(\lambda^2 + \lambda + t - 1) \).

记\( f(\lambda) = \lambda^2 + \lambda + t - 1 \).

当\( f(\lambda) = 0 \)的判别式\( \Delta = 1 - 4(t - 1) > 0 \)，且1不是\( f(\lambda) \)的零点时，\( f(\lambda) = 0 \)的两个不同实根与1构成矩阵\( A \)的三个不同的特征值. 此时，\( A \)相似于实对角矩阵. 联立\( \begin{cases} 1 - 4(t - 1) > 0, \\ 1 + 1 + t - 1 \neq 0 \end{cases} \)可得\( t < \frac{5}{4} \)且\( t \neq -1 \). 而当\( t = -1 \)时，矩阵\( A \)为实对称矩阵，也相似于实对角矩阵. 于是，当\( t < \frac{5}{4} \)时，矩阵\( A \)可相似于实对角矩阵.

当\( t > \frac{5}{4} \)时，\( \Delta < 0 \)，\( f(\lambda) = 0 \)没有实根，矩阵\( A \)仅有一个实特征值1，从而不可能相似于实对角矩阵.

当\( t = \frac{5}{4} \)时，\( f(\lambda) = \left( \lambda + \frac{1}{2} \right)^2 \)，\( -\frac{1}{2} \)是\( A \)的二重特征值. 考虑\( \left( -\frac{1}{2}E - A \right)x = 0 \).

\( -\frac{1}{2}E - A = \begin{pmatrix} -\frac{1}{2} & -\frac{5}{4} & -1 \\ 1 & -\frac{1}{2} & -1 \\ -1 & -1 & -\frac{1}{2} \end{pmatrix} \xrightarrow[r_3 + r_2]{r_2 + 2r_1} \begin{pmatrix} -\frac{1}{2} & -\frac{5}{4} & -1 \\ 0 & -3 & -3 \\ 0 & -\frac{3}{2} & -\frac{3}{2} \end{pmatrix} \to \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 & -\frac{1}{2} \\ 0 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix} \).

由于\( r\left( -\frac{1}{2}E - A \right) = 2 \)，故\( \left( -\frac{1}{2}E - A \right)x = 0 \)仅有一个线性无关的解，从而\( A \)仅有一个线性无关的属于特征值\( -\frac{1}{2} \)的特征向量. 矩阵\( A \)不能相似对角化.

综上所述，\( t \)的取值范围是\( \left( -\infty, \frac{5}{4} \right) \).

questions.stem: （本题满分10分）设二元函数\( z(x,y) \)有连续的偏导数，且\( \frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial x\partial y} = x(\mathrm{e}^y - 1) \)，\( z(x,0) = 0 \)，\( z(0,y) = \frac{y^2}{2} - y \)，求\( z(x,y) \)的极值。
questions.answer:
解 由于\( \frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial x\partial y} = x(\mathrm{e}^y - 1) \)，故

\( \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \int \frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial x\partial y} \mathrm{d}y = \int x(\mathrm{e}^y - 1)\mathrm{d}y = x(\mathrm{e}^y - y) + \varphi(x) \)，

\( z(x,y) = \int \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\mathrm{d}x = \int [x(\mathrm{e}^y - y) + \varphi(x)]\mathrm{d}x = \frac{x^2}{2}(\mathrm{e}^y - y) + \Phi(x) + \Psi(y) \)，

其中\( \Phi(x) \)是一元函数\( \varphi(x) \)的一个原函数，\( \Psi(y) \)是关于\( y \)的一元函数。

在\( z(x,y) = \frac{x^2}{2}(\mathrm{e}^y - y) + \Phi(x) + \Psi(y) \)中分别令\( x = 0 \)，\( y = 0 \)，并结合\( z(x,0) = 0 \)，\( z(0,y) = \frac{y^2}{2} - y \)可得，

\( z(x,0) = \frac{x^2}{2} + \Phi(x) + \Psi(0) = 0 \)， （1）

\( z(0,y) = \Phi(0) + \Psi(y) = \frac{y^2}{2} - y \)． （2）

再在（1）式中令\( x = 0 \)可得\( \Phi(0) + \Psi(0) = 0 \)．（1）式与（2）式相加可得

\( \frac{x^2}{2} + \Phi(x) + \Psi(0) + \Phi(0) + \Psi(y) = \frac{y^2}{2} - y \)．

代入\( \Phi(0) + \Psi(0) = 0 \)并整理可得\( \Phi(x) + \Psi(y) = \frac{y^2}{2} - y - \frac{x^2}{2} \)．

因此，\( z(x,y) = \frac{x^2}{2}(\mathrm{e}^y - y - 1) + \frac{y^2}{2} - y \)．

下面计算\( z(x,y) \)的极值．

先计算\( z(x,y) \)的驻点．

\[

\begin{cases}

z'_x(x,y) = x(\mathrm{e}^y - y - 1), \\

z'_y(x,y) = \frac{x^2}{2}(\mathrm{e}^y - 1) + y - 1.

\end{cases}

\]

令\( \begin{cases} z'_x(x,y) = 0, \\ z'_y(x,y) = 0, \end{cases} \)即\( \begin{cases} x(\mathrm{e}^y - y - 1) = 0, \\ \frac{x^2}{2}(\mathrm{e}^y - 1) + y - 1 = 0. \end{cases} \) 由第一个方程可得\( x = 0 \)或\( y = 0 \)（见注）．将\( x = 0 \)代入第二个方程可得\( y - 1 = 0 \)，即\( y = 1 \)．将\( y = 0 \)代入第二个方程得到\( -1 = 0 \)，矛盾，故舍去．于是，点\( (0,1) \)为\( z(x,y) \)的唯一驻点．

计算\( z(x,y) \)的二阶偏导数．

\( z''_{xx}(x,y) = \mathrm{e}^y - y - 1 \)，\( z''_{xy}(x,y) = x(\mathrm{e}^y - 1) \)，\( z''_{yy}(x,y) = \frac{x^2}{2}\mathrm{e}^y + 1 \)．

代入\( x = 0 \)，\( y = 1 \)可得，

\( A = z''_{xx}(0,1) = \mathrm{e} - 2 \)，\( B = z''_{xy}(0,1) = 0 \)，\( C = z''_{yy}(0,1) = 1 \)．

由于\( AC - B^2 = \mathrm{e} - 2 > 0 \)，且\( A > 0 \)，故由二元函数极值存在的充分条件可得点\( (0,1) \)为\( z(x,y) \)的极小值点，极小值为\( z(0,1) = 0 + \frac{1}{2} - 1 = -\frac{1}{2} \)．

注 下面我们说明$y = 0$是$e^y - y - 1 = 0$的唯一实根。

通过观察不难发现$y = 0$是$e^y - y - 1 = 0$的一个根. 记$f(y) = e^y - y - 1$,则$f'(y) = e^y - 1$,当$y < 0$时,$f'(y) < 0$,$f(y)$单调减少,当$y > 0$时,$f'(y) > 0$,$f(y)$单调增加,从而$y = 0$是$f(y)$的极小值点,也是$f(y)$的唯一零点,从而$y = 0$是$e^y - y - 1 = 0$的唯一实根.

questions.stem:
（本题满分12分）设区域$D$由曲线$x^3 + y^3 - 6xy = 0(x \geq 0, y \geq 0)$围成.

（Ⅰ）求$D$的面积；

（Ⅱ）若$D$的形心的横坐标$\bar{x} = a$，求$\int_{0}^{+\infty} \frac{t^4}{(1 + t^3)^3}dt$，结果用$a$表示.
questions.answer:
（Ⅰ）曲线$x^3 + y^3 - 6xy = 0$的极坐标方程为$r^3\cos^3\theta + r^3\sin^3\theta - 6r^2\cos\theta\sin\theta = 0$，整理可得$r = \frac{6\sin\theta\cos\theta}{\cos^3\theta + \sin^3\theta}$. 由此可得区域$D$的极坐标表示为

$$D = \left\{(r, \theta) \mid 0 \leq r \leq \frac{6\sin\theta\cos\theta}{\cos^3\theta + \sin^3\theta}, 0 \leq \theta \leq \frac{\pi}{2}\right\}.$$

由二重积分的几何意义可得，$D$的面积$= \iint_{D} dxdy$.

$$\iint_{D} dxdy \stackrel{\text{极坐标}}{=} \iint_{D} rdr d\theta = \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} d\theta \int_{0}^{\frac{6\sin\theta\cos\theta}{\cos^3\theta + \sin^3\theta}} rdr = \frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{36\sin^2\theta\cos^2\theta}{(\cos^3\theta + \sin^3\theta)^2}d\theta$$

$$= 18\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{\tan^2\theta}{\left(\frac{\cos^3\theta + \sin^3\theta}{\cos^2\theta}\right)^2}d\theta = 18\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{\tan^2\theta}{(1 + \tan^3\theta)^2} \cdot \frac{1}{\cos^2\theta}d\theta$$

$$= 18\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{\tan^2\theta}{(1 + \tan^3\theta)^2}d(\tan\theta) = 6\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{1}{(1 + \tan^3\theta)^2}d(1 + \tan^3\theta)$$

$$= -\frac{6}{1 + \tan^3\theta}\bigg|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} = 6.$$

（Ⅱ）区域$D$的图形如图所示. 注意到区域$D$关于直线$y = x$对称，故区域$D$对变量$x,y$具有轮换对称性，从而$\iint_{D} xdxdy = \iint_{D} ydxdy$，进一步可得区域$D$的形心的纵坐标$\bar{y} = \bar{x} = a$.

由形心坐标公式可得，$a = \bar{y} = \frac{\iint_{D} ydxdy}{\iint_{D} dxdy}$. 由第（Ⅰ）问的结果可知，$\iint_{D} ydxdy = 6a$.

在极坐标系下计算$\iint_{D} ydxdy$可得，

$$\iint_{D} ydxdy \stackrel{\text{极坐标}}{=} \iint_{D} r\sin\theta \cdot rdr d\theta = \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sin\theta d\theta \int_{0}^{\frac{6\sin\theta\cos\theta}{\cos^3\theta + \sin^3\theta}} r^2 dr$$

$$= 72\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{\sin^4\theta\cos^3\theta}{(\cos^3\theta + \sin^3\theta)^3}d\theta = 72\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{\tan^4\theta}{(\cos^3\theta + \sin^3\theta)^3 \cdot \sec^7\theta}d\theta$$

$$= 72\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{\tan^4\theta}{(1 + \tan^3\theta)^3 \cdot \cos^2\theta}d\theta = 72\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{\tan^4\theta}{(1 + \tan^3\theta)^3}d(\tan\theta)$$

$$\stackrel{t = \tan\theta}{=} 72\int_{0}^{+\infty} \frac{t^4}{(1 + t^3)^3}dt.$$

因此，$72\int_{0}^{+\infty} \frac{t^4}{(1 + t^3)^3}dt = 6a$，$\int_{0}^{+\infty} \frac{t^4}{(1 + t^3)^3}dt = \frac{a}{12}.$

questions.stem: （本题满分12分）设函数$f(x)$满足$f'(1 - x) = 1 - f(x)$，且$\int_{0}^{\pi}[f(x) + (1 + x)f'(x)]\mathrm{d}x = -2$，求$f(x)$。
questions.answer:
解 令$u = 1 - x$，则$f'(u) = 1 - f(1 - u)$，从而$f''(u) = f'(1 - u) = 1 - f(u)$，于是，$f(x)$满足微分方程$f''(x) + f(x) = 1$。

$f''(x) + f(x) = 0$的特征方程为$r^2 + 1 = 0$，有一对共轭复根$r_{1,2} = \pm \mathrm{i}$。于是，该齐次方程的解为$y = C_1\cos x + C_2\sin x$。

由于$1 = \mathrm{e}^{0x}$，而0不是特征方程的根，故可设$f''(x) + f(x) = 1$的一个特解为$y^* = A$。代入原方程可得$A = 1$。于是，$f''(x) + f(x) = 1$的解为$f(x) = C_1\cos x + C_2\sin x + 1$，其中$C_1,C_2$为待定常数。由此可得$f'(x) = -C_1\sin x + C_2\cos x$。

由$f(x) = C_1\cos x + C_2\sin x + 1$可得$f(1 - x) = C_1\cos(1 - x) + C_2\sin(1 - x) + 1$，从而

$$

\begin{align*}

1 - f(1 - x) &= -C_1\cos(1 - x) - C_2\sin(1 - x) \\

&= -C_1(\cos 1\cos x + \sin 1\sin x) - C_2(\sin 1\cos x - \cos 1\sin x) \\

&= (C_2\cos 1 - C_1\sin 1)\sin x - (C_1\cos 1 + C_2\sin 1)\cos x.

\end{align*}

$$

由$f'(x) = 1 - f(1 - x)$可得

$$

-C_1\sin x + C_2\cos x = (C_2\cos 1 - C_1\sin 1)\sin x - (C_1\cos 1 + C_2\sin 1)\cos x.

$$

对比$\sin x,\cos x$的系数可得

$$

\begin{cases}

C_2\cos 1 - C_1\sin 1 = -C_1, \\

C_1\cos 1 + C_2\sin 1 = -C_2.

\end{cases}

$$

第一个方程等价于$C_2 + \frac{1 - \sin 1}{\cos 1}C_1 = 0$，第二个方程等价于$C_1 + \frac{1 + \sin 1}{\cos 1}C_2 = 0$。在$C_2 + \frac{1 - \sin 1}{\cos 1}C_1 = 0$两端同时乘以$\frac{1 + \sin 1}{\cos 1}$，并整理可得$C_1 + \frac{1 + \sin 1}{\cos 1}C_2 = 0$，于是，两方程等价，解该方程组可得$C_2 = -\frac{\cos 1}{1 + \sin 1}C_1$。

另一方面，注意到$[(1 + x)f(x)]' = f(x) + (1 + x)f'(x)$，故

$$

\begin{align*}

-2 &= \int_{0}^{\pi}[f(x) + (1 + x)f'(x)]\mathrm{d}x = (1 + x)f(x)\big|_{0}^{\pi} = (1 + \pi)f(\pi) - f(0) \\

&= (1 + \pi)(1 - C_1) - (1 + C_1) = -(2 + \pi)C_1 + \pi.

\end{align*}

$$

由此可得$-(2 + \pi)C_1 + \pi = -2$，解得$C_1 = 1$。进一步可得$C_2 = -\frac{\cos 1}{1 + \sin 1}$。

因此，$f(x) = \cos x - \frac{\cos 1}{1 + \sin 1}\sin x + 1$。

questions.stem: （本题满分12分）证明：当\( 0 < x \leq 1 \)时，\( 0 < \frac{1}{\arcsin x} - \frac{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}{x} \leq \frac{2}{\pi} \)。
questions.answer:
**证 解法1** 记\( f(x) = \frac{1}{\arcsin x} - \frac{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}{x} \)。

令\( t = \arcsin x \)，则\( x = \sin t \)，\( \sqrt{1 - x^2} = \cos t \)。于是，

\[

g(t) = f(\sin t) = \frac{1}{t} - \frac{\cos t}{\sin t} = \frac{1}{t} - \cot t, \quad 0 < t \leq \frac{\pi}{2}.

\]

要想证明当\( 0 < x \leq 1 \)时，\( 0 < \frac{1}{\arcsin x} - \frac{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}{x} \leq \frac{2}{\pi} \)，只需证明当\( 0 < t \leq \frac{\pi}{2} \)时，\( 0 < g(t) \leq \frac{2}{\pi} \)。

计算\( g'(t) \)可得

\[

g'(t) = -\frac{1}{t^2} + \csc^2 t = -\frac{1}{t^2} + \frac{1}{\sin^2 t} = \frac{(t - \sin t)(t + \sin t)}{t^2 \sin^2 t}.

\]

当\( 0 < t \leq \frac{\pi}{2} \)时，\( \sin t > 0 \)且\( t - \sin t > 0 \)。由此可得，\( g'(t) > 0 \)，\( g(t) \)在\( \left( 0, \frac{\pi}{2} \right] \)上单调增加，从而\( \lim\limits_{x \to 0^+} g(x) < g(t) \leq g\left( \frac{\pi}{2} \right) = \frac{2}{\pi} \)。

计算\( \lim\limits_{x \to 0^+} g(t) \)可得

\[

\begin{align*}

\lim\limits_{t \to 0^+} g(t) &= \lim\limits_{t \to 0^+} \left( \frac{1}{t} - \frac{\cos t}{\sin t} \right) = \lim\limits_{t \to 0^+} \frac{\sin t - t \cos t}{t \sin t} \stackrel{\sin t \sim t}{=} \lim\limits_{t \to 0^+} \frac{\sin t - t \cos t}{t^2} \\

&\stackrel{\text{洛必达}}{=} \lim\limits_{t \to 0^+} \frac{\cos t - \cos t + t \sin t}{2t} = \lim\limits_{t \to 0^+} \frac{t \sin t}{2t} = 0.

\end{align*}

\]

因此，\( 0 < g(t) \leq \frac{2}{\pi} \)，即\( 0 < \frac{1}{\arcsin x} - \frac{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}{x} \leq \frac{2}{\pi} \)

解法2 记\( f(x) = \frac{1}{\arcsin x} - \frac{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}{x} \)。

计算\( f'(x) \)可得

\[

\begin{align*}

f'(x) &= -\frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - x^2} \arcsin^2 x} + \frac{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}{x^2} + \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - x^2}} = -\frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - x^2} \arcsin^2 x} + \frac{1}{x^2 \sqrt{1 - x^2}} \\

&= \frac{\arcsin^2 x - x^2}{x^2 \sqrt{1 - x^2} \arcsin^2 x}.

\end{align*}

\]

由于\( \sqrt{1 - x^2} > 0 \)，\( x^2 \arcsin^2 x > 0 \)，故若\( \arcsin^2 x > x^2 \)，则\( f'(x) > 0 \)。

令\( h(x) = \arcsin x - x \)，则\( h'(x) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - x^2}} - 1 > 0 \)。由此可得，\( h(x) \)在\( (0,1) \)内单调增加，从

而\( h(x) > h(0) = 0 \)，即\( \arcsin x - x > 0 \)。进一步可得，在\( (0,1) \)内，\( f'(x) > 0 \)。于是，\( f(x) \)在\( (0,1) \)内单调增加，从而当\( x \in (0,1] \)时，\( \lim\limits_{x \to 0^+} f(x) < f(x) \leq f(1) = \frac{2}{\pi} \)。

计算\( \lim\limits_{x \to 0^+} f(x) \)可得

\[

\begin{align*}

\lim\limits_{x \to 0^+} f(x) &= \lim\limits_{x \to 0^+} \left( \frac{1}{\arcsin x} - \frac{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}{x} \right) = \lim\limits_{x \to 0^+} \frac{x - \sqrt{1 - x^2} \arcsin x}{x \arcsin x} \\

&\stackrel{\arcsin x \sim x}{=} \lim\limits_{x \to 0^+} \frac{x - \sqrt{1 - x^2} \arcsin x}{x^2} \stackrel{\text{洛必达}}{=} \lim\limits_{x \to 0^+} \frac{1 - 1 + \frac{x}{\sqrt{1 - x^2}} \arcsin x}{2x} = 0.

\end{align*}

\]

因此，\( 0 < \frac{1}{\arcsin x} - \frac{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}{x} \leq \frac{2}{\pi} \)。

questions.stem:
（本题满分12分）设数列\(\{x_n\}\)满足\(x_1 = \frac{1}{2}\)，且对所有正整数\(n\)，\(\frac{1}{x_{n+1}} = \frac{2}{3}\left(\frac{1}{x_n} + \frac{1}{3 - x_n}\right)\).

（Ⅰ）证明\(\lim_{n\to\infty} x_n\)存在，并求其值；

（Ⅱ）求\(\lim_{n\to\infty} 2^{-n}\prod_{i=1}^{n}(3 - x_i)\).
questions.answer:
解 （Ⅰ）由\(\frac{1}{x_{n+1}} = \frac{2}{3}\left(\frac{1}{x_n} + \frac{1}{3 - x_n}\right)\)可得\(x_{n+1} = \frac{3}{2} \cdot \frac{x_n(3 - x_n)}{3} = \frac{1}{2}x_n(3 - x_n)\).

我们先利用数学归纳法证明对所有正整数\(n\)，\(0 < x_n < 1\).

首先，\(0 < x_1 = \frac{1}{2} < 1\).

假设当\(n = k\)时，命题成立，则当\(n = k + 1\)时，由\(x_{k+1} = \frac{1}{2}x_k(3 - x_k)\)可得\(x_{k+1} > 0\)，并且

\[

x_{k+1} = -\frac{1}{2}(x_k^2 - 3x_k) = -\frac{1}{2}\left[\left(x_k - \frac{3}{2}\right)^2 - \frac{9}{4}\right].

\]

注意到函数\(-\frac{1}{2}\left[\left(x - \frac{3}{2}\right)^2 - \frac{9}{4}\right]\)在\((-\infty, \frac{3}{2})\)上单调增加，故当\(x_k < 1\)时，

\[

x_{k+1} < -\frac{1}{2}\left[\left(1 - \frac{3}{2}\right)^2 - \frac{9}{4}\right] = 1.

\]

由数学归纳法可得，对所有正整数\(n\)，\(0 < x_n < 1\).

下面证明数列\(\{x_n\}\)单调增加.

\[

x_{n+1} - x_n = \frac{1}{2}x_n(3 - x_n) - x_n = \frac{1}{2}x_n - \frac{1}{2}x_n^2 = \frac{1}{2}x_n(1 - x_n).

\]

由于\(0 < x_n < 1\)，故\(x_{n+1} - x_n > 0\)，从而数列\(\{x_n\}\)单调增加.

由单调有界准则可知，\(\lim_{n\to\infty} x_n\)存在. 不妨记\(\lim_{n\to\infty} x_n = a\)，则对\(x_{n+1} = \frac{1}{2}x_n(3 - x_n)\)两端取极限可得\(a = \frac{1}{2}a(3 - a)\)，整理可得\(a^2 - a = 0\)，解得\(a = 1\)或\(a = 0\). 又因为\(x_1 = \frac{1}{2} > 0\)，且\(\{x_n\}\)单调增加，所以\(a\)不可能等于0.

因此，\(a = 1\).

（Ⅱ）对\( 2^{-n}\prod_{i=1}^{n}(3 - x_i) \)取对数可得

\[

\ln\left[2^{-n}\prod_{i=1}^{n}(3 - x_i)\right] = \sum_{i=1}^{n}\ln(3 - x_i) - n\ln 2.

\]

由\( x_{n+1} = \frac{1}{2}x_n(3 - x_n) \)可得\( 3 - x_n = \frac{2x_{n+1}}{x_n} \)。于是，

\[

\ln(3 - x_i) = \ln 2 + \ln\frac{x_{i+1}}{x_i} = \ln 2 + \ln x_{i+1} - \ln x_i.

\]

由此可得

\[

\begin{align*}

\sum_{i=1}^{n}\ln(3 - x_i) &= n\ln 2 + (\ln x_2 - \ln x_1) + (\ln x_3 - \ln x_2) + \cdots + (\ln x_{n+1} - \ln x_n) \\

&= n\ln 2 + \ln x_{n+1} - \ln x_1.

\end{align*}

\]

进一步可得

\[

\ln\left[2^{-n}\prod_{i=1}^{n}(3 - x_i)\right] = \ln x_{n+1} - \ln x_1 = \ln x_{n+1} - \ln \frac{1}{2} = \ln x_{n+1} + \ln 2.

\]

于是，

\[

\lim_{n\to\infty}\ln\left[2^{-n}\prod_{i=1}^{n}(3 - x_i)\right] = \lim_{n\to\infty}\ln x_{n+1} + \ln 2 = \lim_{n\to\infty}\ln x_n + \ln 2 \stackrel{\lim_{n\to\infty} x_n = 1}{=} \ln 2.

\]

因此，

\[

\lim_{n\to\infty}2^{-n}\prod_{i=1}^{n}(3 - x_i) = \mathrm{e}^{\lim_{n\to\infty}\ln\left[2^{-n}\prod_{i=1}^{n}(3 - x_i)\right]} = \mathrm{e}^{\ln 2} = 2.

\]

questions.stem: （本题满分12分）设3阶矩阵\( \boldsymbol{A} \)与非零向量\( \boxed{\alpha} \)满足\( \boldsymbol{A}\boxed{\alpha} = \boxed{\alpha} \),不同于\( \boxed{\alpha} \)的向量\( \boxed{\beta} \)满足\( \boldsymbol{A}\boxed{\beta} = \boxed{\alpha} \),向量\( \boxed{\gamma} \)满足\( \boldsymbol{A}\boxed{\gamma} = \boxed{\alpha} + \boxed{\beta} \). 求与\( \boldsymbol{A}^n (n \geq 2) \)相似的对角矩阵.
questions.answer:
解 由于\( \boldsymbol{A}\boxed{\alpha} = \boxed{\alpha} \),\( \boldsymbol{A}\boxed{\beta} = \boxed{\alpha} \),故两式相减可得\( \boldsymbol{A}(\boxed{\alpha} - \boxed{\beta}) = \boxed{0} \),结合\( \boxed{\alpha} \neq \boxed{\beta} \)可得\( \boxed{\alpha} - \boxed{\beta} \)是\( \boldsymbol{A} \)的属于特征值0的一个特征向量. 又因为\( \boldsymbol{A}\boxed{\alpha} = \boxed{\alpha} \),\( \boxed{\alpha} \)是\( \boldsymbol{A} \)的属于特征值1的一个特征向量,所以\( \boxed{\alpha} - \boxed{\beta} \)与\( \boxed{\alpha} \)线性无关.

下面我们证明\( \boxed{\alpha},\boxed{\beta},\boxed{\gamma} \)线性无关.

设常数\( k,l,m \)满足

\( k\boxed{\alpha} + l\boxed{\beta} + m\boxed{\gamma} = \boxed{0}. \) (1)

在(1) 式两端同时左乘\( \boldsymbol{A} \)可得\( k\boldsymbol{A}\boxed{\alpha} + l\boldsymbol{A}\boxed{\beta} + m\boldsymbol{A}\boxed{\gamma} = \boxed{0} \),整理可得\( k\boxed{\alpha} + l\boxed{\alpha} + m(\boxed{\alpha} + \boxed{\beta}) = \boxed{0} \),即

\( (k + l + m)\boxed{\alpha} + m\boxed{\beta} = \boxed{0}. \) (2)

在(2) 式两端同时左乘\( \boldsymbol{A} \)并整理可得\( (k + l + 2m)\boxed{\alpha} = \boxed{0} \). 由于\( \boxed{\alpha} \neq \boxed{0} \),故\( k + l + 2m = 0 \),将该结果代入(2) 式可得\( m(\boxed{\beta} - \boxed{\alpha}) = \boxed{0} \). 又因为\( \boxed{\alpha} - \boxed{\beta} \neq \boxed{0} \),所以\( m = 0 \). 进一步可得\( k + l = 0 \). 将\( m = 0 \),\( k + l = 0 \)代入(1) 式可得\( l(\boxed{\beta} - \boxed{\alpha}) = \boxed{0} \),从而\( l = 0 \),进一步可得\( k = 0 \). 于是,\( k = l = m = 0 \),\( \boxed{\alpha},\boxed{\beta},\boxed{\gamma} \)线性无关.

令\( \boldsymbol{P} = (\boxed{\alpha},\boxed{\beta},\boxed{\gamma}) \),则\( \boldsymbol{P} \)可逆,

\( \boldsymbol{AP} = \boldsymbol{A}(\boxed{\alpha},\boxed{\beta},\boxed{\gamma}) = (\boxed{\alpha},\boxed{\beta},\boxed{\gamma})\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix} = \boldsymbol{P}\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix} \).

由此可得\( \boldsymbol{P}^{-1}\boldsymbol{A}\boldsymbol{P} = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix} \). 进一步可得\( \boldsymbol{P}^{-1}\boldsymbol{A}^n\boldsymbol{P} = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix}^n \).

令\( \boldsymbol{B} = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix} \),下面用数学归纳法证明当\( n \geq 2 \)时,\( \boldsymbol{B}^n = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix} \).

首先,\( \boldsymbol{B}^2 = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix} \).

假设当\( n = k \)时,结论成立,则当\( n = k + 1 \)时,

\( \boldsymbol{B}^{k+1} = \boldsymbol{B}^k\boldsymbol{B} = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix} \)

于是,当\( n = k + 1 \)时,结论也成立. 由数学归纳法可知,当\( n \geq 2 \)时,\( \boldsymbol{B}^n = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix} \).

由此可得,\( \boldsymbol{A}^n \)相似于\( \boldsymbol{C} = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix} \).

由于\( \boldsymbol{C} \)为上三角矩阵,故不难发现其特征值为1,0,0. 又因为\( r(\boldsymbol{C}) = 1 \),\( r(0\boldsymbol{E} - \boldsymbol{C}) = 1 \),所以方程组\( (0\boldsymbol{E} - \boldsymbol{C})\boldsymbol{x} = \boldsymbol{0} \)有两个线性无关的解,从而\( \boldsymbol{C} \)有两个线性无关的属于特征值0的特征向量,进一步可得\( \boldsymbol{C} \)相似于对角矩阵\( \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix} \). 由相似关系的传递性可得\( \boldsymbol{A}^n (n \geq 2) \)相似于对角矩阵\( \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix} \)
